description: Disconnect the custom domain from a link page immediately so that hostname stops serving the page and becomes available again. The /@handle link page itself stays untouched. Ask the user first.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

id.description: A page id from links_list whose custom domain should be disconnected.

name: links_domain_remove
title: Remove a custom domain
